strings: r_c0 is called in to assess m_c's hearing. While it seems okay, m_c always turns {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head away one way to listen.
r_c0 is called in to assess m_c's hearing. It quickly becomes clear m_c can only hear on one side.
m_c often turns {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head when listening, it's clear that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} hearing is limited to one ear.
m_c hardly ever seems to notice noises coming from one side.
